attributes.title: Stagger

lesson.concept: A parent state can orchestrate its descendants
lesson.why: The group propagates a named state and schedules children with a stagger. Each child supplies its own target and spring, so ordering and response remain independently editable.
lesson.experiment: Compare Popcorn with Domino ripple, then reduce the stagger while leaving the child spring unchanged. Notice which part controls order and which controls bounce.
lesson.pitfall: Hard-coding a delay from stale array indices makes order disagree with the rendered collection.
lesson.combine: Combine with presence when the staggered collection also inserts and removes items.
